result.summary: The screen appears to be a mockup or a stylized representation rather than a real application interface, leading to several visual inconsistencies.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card is truncated. The text is clipped off at the end, and the visual card is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or horizontal scrolling constraints to ensure the full name and card edge are visible.

issues.description: The '-0%' badge on the bottom pizza card is misleading and serves no functional purpose, as a zero percent discount is not a promotion.
issues.suggestion: Remove the '-0%' badge entirely as it provides no value to the user and looks like a data placeholder.

issues.description: The visual elements (illustrations) appear to be generic placeholders or low-detail icons that contrast sharply with the professional UI text, making the application feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Replace these generic illustrations with actual photos of the food items from the respective restaurants to provide a more authentic and visually appealing experience.
